d: We are seeking technically skilled and detail-oriented professionals for the positions of Mechanical Engineer / Production Engineer. These roles focus on mechanical system design, manufacturing operations, production planning, equipment optimization, and the development of efficient engineering solutions. The ideal candidates should demonstrate strong technical knowledge, analytical thinking, practical problem-solving abilities, and an understanding of manufacturing processes, equipment performance, and industrial engineering standards.

Responsibilities include designing, evaluating, and improving mechanical systems, production equipment, and manufacturing processes to ensure operational efficiency and product quality. Mechanical Engineers will support equipment design, technical calculations, component evaluation, system troubleshooting, and mechanical maintenance activities. Production Engineers will focus on production planning, process optimization, workflow improvement, equipment utilization, and manufacturing performance monitoring. Additional duties include reviewing engineering drawings and specifications, identifying production bottlenecks, investigating equipment failures, implementing corrective actions, and coordinating with quality assurance, maintenance, and production teams. They will also prepare technical reports, monitor production indicators, evaluate manufacturing methods, and contribute to continuous improvement initiatives involving productivity, safety, cost efficiency, and product reliability.
Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Industrial Engineering, or a related discipline.
Strong understanding of mechanical engineering principles and manufacturing processes.
Knowledge of production planning, process optimization, and equipment performance evaluation.
Familiarity with engineering drawings, technical specifications, and mechanical design concepts.
Understanding of quality control, preventive maintenance, and industrial safety practices.
Proficiency in AutoCAD, SolidWorks, or other relevant engineering software.
Ability to analyze production data and identify operational improvement opportunities.
Strong analytical, mathematical, and problem-solving abilities.
Excellent communication, teamwork, and technical documentation skills.
High attention to detail and commitment to engineering quality, production efficiency, and continuous improvement.
